newsitem.title: USA: U.S. West Coast products flat in late Thurs. trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. West Coast products flat in late Thurs. trade.

text.p: U.S. West Coast product prices remained mostly flat in late Thursday trade, as lower heating oil prices and tight supplies left values with little direction.
West Coast petroleum products held at morning levels, which rose half a cent from Wednesday amid declining output from key regional refineries.
Perceptions of lower stocks offset a 0.40 cent-fall in January heating oil and modest gains in gasoline.
Los Angeles CARB diesel saw a half cent rise from early levels to 74/75 cents a gallon, while bids for low sulphur diesel edged up 0.50 cent from this morning to 71.50 cents.
Conventional regular unleaded gasoline in Los Angeles stayed flat at 72/73 cents a gallon.
Offers for CARB-grade material in L.A. saw a notional decline of 0.50 cents to 75.50 cents a gallon.
The higher price for premium CARB gasoline in L.A. tightened to 2.00 cents over CARB regular levels.
